name: 絞り込み結果の通知帯
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One Lighthouse component LH09-0008 絞り込み結果の通知帯.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL image1 controls icon glyph geometry, proportions, opticalstroke, alignment, spacing and finecontrol anatomy; our mock image2 is SECONDARY for Japanese copy/layout, not its rough glyphs or oversized gaps. Image3 is official white/materialstyle only, no buscontent.
Single quiet compact horizontal notice on purewhite #FFFFFF. Exact Japanese statement「1件の課題が条件により非表示です」followed with a restrained gap by green text action「絞り込みを解除」and original small thin slate X immediately after action, as source. Keep X near action, do not invent a separate far-right dismisscontrol. No rounded filledbutton or cardwrapper: this is a contextual utilitylink, not a dominant primaryCTA. No addedicons, counts, row, heading or explanatorytext.
Meiryo Regular12/16 for compact notice/action, zero tracking; normalweight. Maincopy #1D1D1D, action #1F6444, X #526173. Match original smallcontrol proportions andaligned baselines, Japanesecomplete onone line. White surface with minimal neutral separation, no mint fill, coloredglow or shadowbox. Keep540x40 logical component anatomy and tight framing withminimalouterwhitepadding. Staticrastercandidate only.
reviewNotes: 全原画像・個別切抜き・モックを実見。1件の課題が条件により非表示です/絞り込みを解除を全文確認。原画像に従い小Xを解除操作の近くに配置、余分な閉じる操作やカードを未追加。既存の緑テキスト操作、補助スレート、白面。生成外周余白あり。厳密な書体同一性やXの実動作は未検証。エージェント候補目視確認のみ、所有者承認・ネイティブ・アプリ実装とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
